subject: I get some error with R 3.1.0 and Rattle 3.0.3

messages.author: a5ec4fe44d841052
messages.subject: I get some error with R 3.1.0 and Rattle 3.0.3
parts:
Hi everyone,

Sorry if my question appears to be silly, I'm very new with R and Rattle.

I spent a week playing around with R and Rattle on MacOSX 10.9 and got some problems. Firstly I couldn't make Rattle to startup properly. There're always something wrong with the RGtk2 library. After dealing with Rattle version 3.0.3, my first problem solved, but another one appeared. I got error message "Error in executeClusterKMeans(include) : attempt to apply non-function" when trying to cluster my data set using K-Means algorithm, really don't know how to go up with that. 

Any one got some ideas for that?

Thank you for your time!

This is fixed in Rattle 3.0.4

> install.packages("rattle", repos="http://rattle.togaware.com", type="source")
